تستهلي (form X)
# تَسْتَهِلِّي (tastahillī) /tas.ta.hil.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# تُسْتَهَلِّي (tustahallī) /tus.ta.hal.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
